name: TCG Operating Pack
description: The Common Ground operating system: programs, projects, experiments, places, people, funding, media and finance — databases, dashboards and page templates.

records.title: Parambu Habitat
body: Base habitat of The Common Ground in Parambu, Ceará.
Use this record as the capture context for field observations, expenses and tasks on site.

blocks.text: The Common Ground operating system — programs, projects, land, people, money and media in one graph.
Everything assigned to you, and the records you own.
Programs are the long arcs; projects hang underneath them. Keep one note per program here.
One line per program — health, next milestone, and what it needs this month.
Experiments and the field log. The L-board method: observe, explore, experiment, evolve.
The land graph — every place carries its own page, projects, events and field log.
Each place gets a child page with its own dashboard — see Parambu Habitat below.
Base habitat in Parambu, Ceará. Habitat record: @[rec:r_parambu]
Members, volunteers, partners — the people who make the ground common.
Grants, CSR, donations and sponsorships — the pipeline that funds the work.
Workshops, courses and volunteer days at the habitat and beyond.
Articles, videos and courses that carry the work outward.
Every meeting produces decisions; every decision links back to the projects it changes.
The intake. Approved ideas convert to projects — set "Converted to project" and the stage moves to Converted.
Operations & finance — money in, money out, by project and event.
What we know — research notes, SOPs and policies, kept as living pages.
Research Notes — experiment write-ups and reference material.
SOPs & Policies — how we run the ground.
Experiment write-ups, literature notes, and reference material. Use the Research Note template.
Standard operating procedures and policies. One page per SOP; keep them short and testable.
Archived projects and records live here — hidden from views, still searchable.
Page templates for the operating rhythm — project kickoffs, reviews, field visits, grants.
Create from these via the "+" template picker.
Project brief for {{project}} — set the record fields (owner, program, places, dates, budget), then work this page top-down.
Experiment: {{experiment}} — the L-board method: observe, explore, experiment, evolve.
Field visit to {{place}} on {{date}} — capture observations into the Field Log.
What to measure, units, sampling notes.
Attach photos to this page or link Drive folders.
Week of {{week}} — the weekly rhythm: numbers first, then people, then decisions.
Review of {{project}} — honest answers, evidence over impressions.
What could become a course, article or video?
Link the project’s tasks, decisions and media. The blocks below show open items across the workspace — filter them to {{project}} when reviewing.
Where did we over/under-spend vs plan?
Quarterly strategy — {{quarter}}. Step back: what does the ground need next?
The 1–3 things we commit to this quarter.
What this changes for the work.
Case study — {{project}}. Tell it like a story someone could repeat.
Photos, measurements, quotes — link the field log and media records.
